packet.name: UDP
pdus: 0-15: Source Port (optional), Destination Port, Length (16 bits), Checksum (16 bits), Data

fields.name: source_port
fields.description: Optional field indicating the port of the sending process.

fields.name: destination_port
fields.description: The port of the receiving process.

fields.name: length
fields.description: The length in octets of this user datagram including header and data. Minimum value is eight.

fields.name: checksum
fields.description: The 16-bit one's complement of the one's complement sum of pseudo header, UDP header, and data.

parsing_context.name: IP_header
parsing_context.description: Used to extract source address, destination address, protocol field, and UDP length from the internet datagram.

transform_functions.name: checksum_calculation
transform_functions.from: source_address, destination_address, protocol, UDP length, UDP header, data
transform_functions.description: Computes the checksum using one's complement sum of pseudo-header and data padded to multiple of two octets.
